## Purpose

Describe the course-independent problem and affected platform adapter.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No real course content, student data, answers, credentials or local paths.
- [ ] Shared core updated before or with adapter copies.
- [ ] Human gates, audience separation and inactive defaults are preserved.
- [ ] Platform claims cite current official documentation.
- [ ] New executable behavior is disabled by default and clearly disclosed.

## Validation

- [ ] Repository validator passes.
- [ ] Unit and platform-specific tests pass.
- [ ] Public scrub passes.
- [ ] Deterministic archive and inventory checks pass.
